state_predicates.reentry: local avatar exists AND (flags_qword0 & (1<<48)) !=0 AND (flags_qword1 & (1<<44)) ==0; overall bit108 is flags[13]&0x10. No saved preference or writes in predicate.
state_predicates.controller_enter: controller+4==0 && mask==0 && controller+5==0 && allowed weapon; then+4=1 and native constructor/evaluator
state_predicates.controller_exit: only if controller+4!=0; clear+4 then native FPS exit
state_predicates.request_constructor: only current topkind4; otherwise return, including existingkind6
state_predicates.saved_preference: getter0xa426a0 chooses weaponRows[index*2] for settings modes1/3, player+index*0x38+0x2ec for modes0/2; not a persistent hip-FP request
state_predicates.aim_exit: 0xa41ed0 clears transient desired field+0xd at0xa420aa and, when applicable, clears native flag48 at0xa4215a..0xa4218a

fallback_lifetime.save: Normal constructor0x127bbd0 stores selected packet in record+a4..b4 at0x127c6f4/6f8, then copies complete record to saved fallback context+1f00 at0x127c9bf..0x127ca48.
fallback_lifetime.queue_progress: 0x12797bc..0x1279818 updates records at context+0x200+slot*0xe8; the saved fallback is not that slot and is not updated by this loop.
fallback_lifetime.exit: FP_EXIT marks oldkind6 as kind0/current pose with0x12771d0, then copies saved fallback to tail and calls native request update and post-camera rig update withdt0.
fallback_lifetime.completed_question: Not generally an already-completed old queue packet: saved copy keeps creation values. Rows40..44 initialize progress==duration, so an authored packet can be complete at birth. Current live saved packet must be observed.

schedule.request_evaluation: 0x1279190 iterates head..tail and dispatches each request type; kind6 calls0x1286330 at0x1279643 before updating that request timers.
schedule.cull: If newest zero-packet kind6 hasprogress>=duration(0>=0), queued older requests are discarded by movinghead to newest at0x127987e..0x12798c3.
schedule.post_rig: 0x127a420 iterates queue and calls0x1288920 for each kind6 at0x127a51f.
schedule.multi_evaluation_caveat: Nonzero new-FPS packet can keep multiple requests evaluating concurrently. Current top snapshot alone does not identify the evaluator request. Any future parameter experiment needs actual evaluation identity, request lifetime, active/retired rig ownership and foreign writer proof.
schedule.second_position_filter: Separate coefficient xmm9 iszeroed forkind6 or completed-kind6 boundary at0x12799f1..0x1279a21. At0x127a04c/0x127a0b1 zero selects alpha1, so native positional lag does not smooth activeFPS. Do not confuse this coefficient with per-request duration.

desired_function_identity.owner_derivation: Avatar update uses manager+avatar_index*0x1238+0x53d8b0 at0x82a0af..d4, calls0xa3e620 on+0x50 at0x82a497, which calls0xa41100 on+0x3b4 at0xa3e735. Thus candidate aim-state block is avatar_manager+index*0x1238+0x53dcb4; independently close block+0x10==current avatar. Manager argument identity must be qualified before runtime use.

observed_fields.0x8: auxiliary transition/input float; exact semantic name not established

mechanism_conclusion.supported: The game provides a real native request blend packet, authored pair/profile table, curve functions, per-request timed evaluation, retirement to current camera pose and saved fallback publication. This can blend camera position/quaternion/FOV natively without synthetic input.
mechanism_conclusion.not_supported_yet: No independent persistent non-ADS FPS state, no FPS constructor duration argument, no exposed gameplay SDK blend setter, no callable helper that both preserves complete FPS rig and smoothly releases native ADS has been qualified. Packet writes or suppressing exit are not drop-in fixes.
mechanism_conclusion.snap_hypothesis: If mod reentry appends zero-packet kind6 before native exit blend finishes, next native queue update immediately discards older transition requests and bypasses position lag. This is a code-supported mechanism hypothesis, not a measured cause of current on-screen snap.
mechanism_conclusion.rig_limit: Generic camera blend packets do not establish blending of native weapon/hand animation or visibility cleanup. Native FPS exit performs rig/body/near-plane restoration before generic blend; camera smoothing alone does not guarantee cohesive arms.

remaining_live_predicates: Current queue head/tail/top and ALL live request kinds, avatar/weapon identity, blend packets and target pose blocks+b8..+e7 across aimrelease
Savedfallback kind/profile and+a4..b4 packet versus queued copy before/after retirement; do not infer completion from duration alone
Transient aim block+c/+d/+4 andflag48/flag108, controller mask/+4/+5 and saved ADS preference without mutation
Actual native evaluator request argument and evaluation phase/thread, distinct fromtop; post-rig update argument and preserved nativeinput/animation
Vehicle/seat identity corresponding to observed mask2/8/10/20/40, flags and nativekind5/10 transitions; address families alone are not class labels
Root0/branch5/camera50/actualcamera world matrices plus fullgun hierarchy; boundedsynchronizedframe comparison
Native dt units and whether fallbackprogress isinitial or alteredbyanothernativeproducer/third-partywriter
First-native-evaluation that culls old requests after modkind6 reentry versus the on-screenjump
rejected_alternatives: Use saved ADS preference as permanent hip FPS: controls native aiming view only
Call controller_enter repeatedly or write transient+d: native aim-exit and suppression paths overwrite them
Clear native action masks: defeats native lifecycle ownership and can reenter incompatible actions/vehicles
Skip native FPS exit: loses its body/rig/lens restoration contract; no qualified alternative cleanup
Write nonzero packet on newkind6 as a drop-in: multiple live request evaluation/pose ownership unproved
Assume transition table6->4 isactualFP_EXIT packet: exit copies savedfallback instead oflookup
Assume oldsavedfallbackprogress equalscompletedformerqueueslot: queueupdates a differentcopy
Interpret zeroed separate positionlag coefficient aszero requestduration: separate stages
